hypotheses.claim: On cvrp_dev_hetero_24 at 2000 ms, replacing the fixed load-saturation gate exponent with a self-normalizing exponent gamma = 1 + clip(mean_route_saturation - 0.5, 0, 0.4), applied as gate_load = (1 - route_loads/capacity)^gamma * (1 + 0.5*route_dists/mean(route_dists)), and setting the stagnation rank power to p = 1.25 + 1.0*stagnation_ratio with no additive slack term, will lower mean objective below the round-7 SBS 15.8554 (and the round-5 15.8374 frontier) because tight-capacity instances (12/24 of the suite) receive a steeper under-load emphasis that concentrates ruin on degenerate near-empty routes, while clustered/eccentric instances are unaffected by the exponent change since their mean saturation is near 0.5.

next_search_advice.direction: Refine the round-7 supported destroy score into a saturation-normalized form: keep the multiplicative depot-distance gate and stale-route load gate but (a) rescale each route's load gate by the *instance-observed* mean route saturation (mean(route_loads)/capacity) so the gate's slope adapts to tight-capacity instances instead of using a fixed exponent, and (b) drive the rank exponent from stagnation only (p = 1.25 + 1.0*stagnation_ratio, no additive slack term, no sector-coherence term). Target: cut the tight-capacity / size-100 / eccentric-depot residual gap (currently ~21-23% VBS-relative) without perturbing the clustered regime where round-7 is already SBS-co-equal.
